name: Snowdrops
source:
It is an adaptation of a Christmas story that tells how a stepmother sent her stepdaughter to the forest for snowdrops by order of the queen, on the eve of the new year.

[From [url=https://hloramin.itch.io/snowdrops]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
该剧改编自圣诞故事，讲述了继母在新年前夕奉女王之命将继女送到森林里采雪花莲的故事。

[来自[url=https://hloramin.itch.io/snowdrops]Itch.io[/url]]
